name: Grimtotem Marauders charge a victim 8-25 yd away (#12577)
contract: Grimtotem Marauder 161809 carries the SmartAI range event 'Victim 8-25 yd - Cast Charge' (22120, 0-30 yd).
Its range sat in the timer parameters, so the range check was 0-0 yd and the Marauder only walked to its
victim. Expected: a hostile Marauder fixture 15 yd from a mage that hits it with Fireball casts Charge 22120
within 6 s; the broken row never casts it, because Charge cannot fire once the Marauder stands in melee.

steps.label: SETUP: the Marauder stands 8-25 yd away
Fireball pulls the Marauder from range
SETUP: the Marauder is in combat
The Marauder casts Charge at its victim
